files.file: Stops reached by a walk edge become ("wk", id) nodes that can only board or finish, so walk edges cannot chain (transfer, pre-ride and post-ride walks capped at one hop).
Treat ("wk", id) like ("at", id) when boarding.
Regression test: chained 60 m hops beyond TRANSFER_RADIUS_M give no path.

tests.test: tests/planner and full suite pass (see commands).

design_decisions.decision: Enforce the one-hop limit in search via wk state nodes; rejected changing Graph adjacency (would break the spec edge test and graph shape).

implementation.self_critique: Pre-ride walk is now start walk plus at most one hop; not re-verified live on the seeded DB.
